import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { film } from "./film";
import { store } from "./store";
import { rental } from "./rental";

export const inventory = defineTable("inventory", {
    columns: {
        inventoryId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        filmId: col.integer().notNull(),
        storeId: col.integer().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        film: rel.belongsTo(() => film),
        store: rel.belongsTo(() => store),
        rental: rel.hasMany(() => rental)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
